title: Weather
description: Current weather and forecast for your location, from SMHI, Open-Meteo, WeatherAPI or OpenWeather.

provider.title: Weather provider
provider.help: SMHI is recommended for the Nordics, Open-Meteo is key-less and global, WeatherAPI and OpenWeather require API keys.

weatherapi_key.title: API key
weatherapi_key.description: API key from WeatherAPI.com (required if WeatherAPI is selected).

openweathermap_key.title: API key
openweathermap_key.description: API key from OpenWeatherMap (required if OpenWeatherMap is selected).

forecast_days.title: Forecast days
forecast_days.description: Number of days to show in the daily forecast.

forecast_type.title: Forecast type
forecast_type.description: Select forecast data: daily (upcoming days), hourly (upcoming hours), or combined (both today's hours and upcoming days).

layout.title: Look
layout.description: Select the visual style: horizontal (wider grid timeline/columns) or vertical (original list/rows).

warnings.title: Weather warnings
warnings.description: Weather warnings for your location, under the current weather.
warnings.help: From SMHI and WeatherAPI; Open-Meteo and OpenWeather have none. Messages are SMHI's calmer notices, such as a risk of water shortage.

forecast_hours.title: Forecast hours
forecast_hours.description: Number of hours to show in the hourly timeline.

outdoor_temperature_event.title: Outdoor temperature from
outdoor_temperature_event.description: Use your own outdoor temperature, sent as a public event by another module.
outdoor_temperature_event.help: The public event of a module that sends your own outdoor temperature, such as mirrordash_homeassistant.sensor.outdoor_temperature. It must send {"value": 3.4, "unit": "°C"}. Replaces the provider's current temperature while readings arrive; after 10 minutes without one the provider's comes back. Empty: off.
outdoor_temperature_event.pattern_message: An event name: a module's package name, a dot and the event, such as mirrordash_homeassistant.sensor.outdoor_temperature

outdoor_humidity_event.title: Outdoor humidity from
outdoor_humidity_event.description: Use your own outdoor humidity, sent as a public event by another module.
outdoor_humidity_event.help: The public event of a module that sends your own outdoor humidity, such as mirrordash_homeassistant.sensor.outdoor_humidity. It must send {"value": 82, "unit": "%"}. Shown with the current details while readings arrive; after 10 minutes without one it disappears. Empty: off.
outdoor_humidity_event.pattern_message: An event name: a module's package name, a dot and the event, such as mirrordash_homeassistant.sensor.outdoor_humidity

interval.title: Update interval
interval.description: Time to wait between data refreshes (15 minutes recommended).
